title: How Micah Bell got into Dutch's gang in Red Dead 2
subject: micah
description:
Would you have left Micah in that cell? 👇

How Micah Bell earned Dutch's trust in Red Dead Redemption 2, starting with a jailbreak in Strawberry. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption 2.

scenes.text: Arthur Morgan saved Micah Bell's life, and the gang paid for it.
Micah had ridden with Dutch for about six months when the Blackwater ferry job fell apart in 1899.
While the gang hid in the mountains, he landed in a jail cell in Strawberry.
Arthur broke him out in a mission called Who Is Without Sin.
Micah didn't just run. He went back for his guns and shot his way through town, lawman after lawman.
Dutch saw a loyal gun. Arthur saw trouble from the very first ride.
That rescue kept Micah at Dutch's side until the end.
